from.place: Proper and affine cases: compatibility of Kummer exact sequences, degree maps, and pullback under k ⊂ k'

title: Kummer sequences and affine Picard torsion commute with algebraically closed base change
statement: Let $k\subseteq k'$ be an extension of algebraically closed fields [def-sc-field-extension], let $C$ be a smooth separated connected curve over $k$ [def-sc-curves], and let $n\geq1$ be prime to $\operatorname{char}k$. Write $\pi:C_{k'}\to C$ for the base-change morphism and let $c:\pi^{-1}\mathbf G_{m,C}\to\mathbf G_{m,C_{k'}}$ be the comparison map adjoint to pullback of units; let $c|_{\mu_n}:\pi^{-1}\mu_{n,C}\to\mu_{n,C_{k'}}$ be its restriction. Then $(c|_{\mu_n},c,c)$ is a morphism of short exact Kummer sequences [def-sc-kummer-sequence] for $C$ and $C_{k'}$, and the maps of the resulting Kummer long exact sequences are $H^q(c|_{\mu_n})\circ\rho^q_{k'/k}(C,\mu_n)$ and $H^q(c)\circ\rho^q_{k'/k}(C,\mathbf G_m)$ (with the evident analogous map on the final $\mathbf G_m$ term). In degree zero the latter is pullback of global units [lem-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback-degree-zero]. Under [lem-sc-h1-gm-pic-pullback], $H^1(c)\circ\rho^1_{k'/k}(C,\mathbf G_m)$ corresponds to $\mathcal L\mapsto\pi^*\mathcal L$. If $C$ is affine, then pullback induces an isomorphism $\operatorname{Pic}(C)[n]\xrightarrow{\sim}\operatorname{Pic}(C_{k'})[n]$.

proof.text: Map the unit n in k to global sections of C and then along pi to global sections of P. Apply Kummer exactness to both schemes. The comparison of units commutes with n times the identity by additivity of inverse image. Its composite with the inverse image of the kernel inclusion is killed by n, so the kernel universal property gives the roots-of-unity component and its commuting square.

Apply the pullback cohomology long exact ladder to the Kummer sequence of C. Identify its connecting maps with Sheaf.H.deltaSucc using the given extClass formulas. Compose with Sheaf.H.map_deltaSucc for the constructed short-complex morphism. The other two squares follow by applying Sheaf.H.map to its commuting-square identities and using map_comp_apply.

Use the curve base-change theorem and the homeomorphism from the specified pullback square to the categorical pullback to give P its curve structure. Apply Picard cohomology pullback: its second clause proves the units formula. Represent a Picard class by its invertible skeleton representative. Tensor pullback and Modules.pullback are left adjoints to the same pushforward, hence naturally isomorphic; this identifies the class of tensor pullback with Pic.map. The first clause proves the degree-one formula.
When C is affine, define the subtype map by Pic.map pi and preservation of powers. Its bijectivity is [lem-sc-affine-picard-torsion-base-change], and its underlying-value formula is reflexivity.
